text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"formal salutation and closing","quality":"letter format","description":"Uses a recognizable persuasive-letter structure with an opening address, organized body, and polite closing."},{"evidence":"longer connected arguments with transitions like \"In additon\" and \"Again\"","quality":"argument development","description":"Develops reasons in a more extended, organized way rather than relying mostly on brief warnings and assertions."},{"evidence":"specific references to cafeteria food, health, and weight","quality":"topic-specific detail","description":"Includes more concrete supporting details tied to the prompt and the writer's position."},{"evidence":"\"my opponents would argue\" and \"when they detect my reasons\"","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"Shows more awareness of an opposing view and attempts to address it."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"definetely,\" \"regardlessly,\" and \"the school's lunch is way better than they think it is\"","quality":"academic stance","description":"Maintains a more explicitly persuasive, school-appropriate argumentative tone."}]}
